title: DigiByte Wallet News
description: DigiByte Wallet releases and development news

items.title: DigiByte Core v9.26.7: Small Follow‑up Fixes and Wallet Detail Improvements
items.summary: The DigiByte Core v9.26.7 release, published on 6 Oct 2026, addresses slow chain‑information requests, a shutdown fatal‑error, and refines three wallet UI details. It adds five user‑facing changes and ten total fixes without altering block‑validation rules or Thaw Day activation heights.

items.title: DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5 is now available on the App Store
items.summary: DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5 is now listed on Apple's App Store, bringing security dependency updates, improved iPhone startup reliability, Send All fixes, and clearer controls.

items.title: DigiByte Wallet Highlights 256-Bit Recovery as 0.1.5 Security Work Advances
items.summary: DigiByte Wallet's new-wallet setup uses 256-bit BIP39 entropy and a 24-word recovery phrase. Recent development work also strengthens iOS Keychain reliability, certificate validation, and app usability ahead of version 0.1.5.

items.title: DigiCoinLib 0.0.3: A stronger foundation for DigiByte Wallet
items.summary: A new open-source DigiByte library update improves compatibility with modern Android tooling, corrects test-network handling and strengthens automated tests while preserving standard mainnet wallet behavior.

items.title: DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5: Original preview (November 5)
items.summary: Archived November 5 development preview: DigiByte Wallet 0.1.5 has since been released on the App Store. Read the newer release announcement for current availability.
